notes: «حدثتني جدتاى، صفية ودحيبة» names the two grandmothers: their relation word is absorbed in the names (rule 7)
«دحيبة» is written without the patronymic «ابنتا عليبة» that follows it in the text
«- تعني حريث بن حسان ... -» is an editor's gloss: left out
Qayla tells the saying (her companion's embassy and the Prophet's words): she is the last link
